headline: Smooth boards after Remove object
summary: The board no longer slows down after you remove an object, draw on a photo, or zoom into a big one.

fixed.title: No lag after Remove object
fixed.description: Panning and zooming stay smooth while the tool is open and after Apply.
fixed.details: Before, the edited photo was drawn at full size every frame, so the board stayed slow until you reopened it.

fixed.title: No lag after drawing or zooming in
fixed.description: Drawing on a big photo, or zooming into one and back out, no longer slows the board.
